raw_segments.text: Ophidias, therefore most absolute, sir, if thou wilt have the leading of thine own revenges,
take T.H., one half of my commission, and set down, as best thou art experienced, since
thou know'st'y thy country's strength and weakness, thine own ways, whether to knock
against the gates of Rome, or rudely visit them in parts remote to fright them ere destroy.
Let me commend thee first to those that shall say yea to thy desires.
And more a friend than heir and enemy, yet, Martius, that was much, your hand, most welcome.
